scope: Correct real ATA parallel-port command interrupt ordering. This is not claimed as the Win98 IDE Code10 or file-cache-corruption root cause.
failure: The old port handler executed the new ATA command before lowering IRQ. A synchronous IDENTIFY/data-ready/error completion could assert INTRQ and immediately have it withdrawn by that same command write.
change: Lower the previous IRQ before clearing command error flags and dispatching the new command; leave the new completion asserted until normal status acknowledgement.

validation.regression: tests/devices/ide_command_irq.js uses real ATA/ATAPI ports and the real Rust8259 via machine_io_read8/write8. Old source fails IDENTIFY with level IRQ14 pending0 instead of64.
validation.green: Source/debug and release pass both channels, edge/level routing, IDENTIFY, synchronous FLUSH/error, synchronous PIO payload, alternate-status non-acknowledgement, regular-status deassertion and nIEN suppression.
validation.regressions: Source/release task-file progress and large-disk tests pass; source image-error/writeback tests pass; all33 release AHCI tests pass.
validation.build: Release libv86 Closure:0errors/0warnings; debug Wasm rebuild and source tests pass.
validation.native: Cold Win98 with repaired ISA loader still reports IDE child Code10 after the IRQ change. This real interrupt bug is fixed, while startup and03 cached-source investigations remain open.
